title: Phase 5 — synthesis and on-board inference
description: Full FINN bitstream synthesis and PYNQ-driven on-board inference. Requires Vivado >= 2022.2, the pinned board, and a working rootless-Podman host.
acceptance_criteria: .bit + .hwh produced; on-board detections verified to match host QAT outputs; latency/throughput measured. Reviewed and approved by Samuel before close.

title: Hardware fit
description: Confirms the quantized model actually fits the target Zynq board before committing to synthesis.

title: Pin the exact Zynq board + part number
description: Advisor specified 'Zynq' and separately the Nexys Video (Artix-7, largest fabric available) as the biggest board on hand. Zynq was chosen as primary since FINN has a native shell for it; Nexys Video has no PS and would need a hand-built Vivado harness. The exact Zynq part (e.g. Pynq-Z1/Z2, Zybo) is still unconfirmed.
design: Blocks Epic 5 entirely. Once pinned, also feeds folding_config and the FINN board alias in configs/finn.yaml.
acceptance_criteria: Advisor confirms the exact Zynq board/part; configs/finn.yaml target_fpga is set accordingly. Reviewed and approved by Samuel before close.

title: Phase 4 — FINN dataflow compilation
description: Compiles the QONNX graph via FINN inside a Podman container, up to the Vivado-free stop_step gate; hardware-fit checking against the target board happens here too.
acceptance_criteria: finn-run produces finn_output/intermediate_models/step_qonnx_to_finn.onnx; estimate reports parse and resource usage fits the chosen board. Reviewed and approved by Samuel before close.

title: Phase 3 — export to FINN-compatible ONNX
description: Exports the QAT checkpoint to a QONNX graph FINN can parse.
acceptance_criteria: export-model --weights <qat best.pt> produces *.qonnx.onnx and *.scale.npy that pass the export graph test. Reviewed and approved by Samuel before close.

title: Phase 2 — quantization-aware training
description: Brevitas QAT fine-tuning: patch the model to quantized layers, then fine-tune from the FP32 checkpoint.
acceptance_criteria: qat --weights <fp32 best.pt> --data <dataset.yaml> produces a state_dict-only QAT checkpoint with a recorded mAP delta vs. the T1.1.4 baseline. Reviewed and approved by Samuel before close.

title: Phase 1 — full-precision YOLO training
description: Baseline FP32 training via Ultralytics; the reference point quantization accuracy is measured against.
acceptance_criteria: train --data <dataset.yaml> produces a checkpoint at runs/train/<name>/weights/best.pt with a recorded baseline mAP. Reviewed and approved by Samuel before close.

title: Project foundation & scaffolding
description: Everything the rest of the pipeline depends on: dev environment, package structure, docs, and the tracker itself.
acceptance_criteria: devenv shell resolves, pytest and ruff pass, qyf --help lists all subcommands, bd list --tree renders the full hierarchy. Reviewed and approved by Samuel before close.

title: Accuracy comparison table: FP32 vs QAT vs ONNX
description: The academic write-up input — quantifies the accuracy cost at each pipeline stage.
acceptance_criteria: A comparison table across FP32/QAT/ONNX mAP is produced and recorded. Reviewed and approved by Samuel before close.

title: ONNX inference path (raw outputs, no NMS)
description: Exercises the exported QONNX graph directly, exposing raw outputs for comparison against host QAT results.
acceptance_criteria: infer --weights <best.qonnx.onnx> --format onnx produces raw (non-NMS'd) outputs. Reviewed and approved by Samuel before close.

title: Implement stages/infer.py — .pt path
description: Standard Ultralytics inference against a full-precision or QAT .pt checkpoint.
acceptance_criteria: infer --weights <best.pt> --source <image/dir> --save runs inference and saves annotated output. Reviewed and approved by Samuel before close.

title: Inference stage
description: Implements stages/infer.py for both native and exported checkpoint formats.

title: Host inference & accuracy evaluation
description: Standalone inference stage and the FP32-vs-QAT-vs-ONNX accuracy comparison. Runs in parallel with Epics 2-4 once Epic 1 lands.
acceptance_criteria: infer works for both .pt and ONNX checkpoints; a comparison table across FP32/QAT/ONNX accuracy is produced. Reviewed and approved by Samuel before close.

title: Measure latency and throughput on hardware
description: The hardware performance numbers the academic write-up needs alongside the accuracy comparison from Epic 6.
acceptance_criteria: Latency and throughput are measured on the board and recorded on this bead's notes. Reviewed and approved by Samuel before close.

title: Verify on-board detections match host QAT outputs
description: Uses the per-layer scales from T3.1.3 to de-quantize on-board outputs for a like-for-like comparison.
acceptance_criteria: On-board detections for a test image match host QAT inference within an acceptable tolerance. Reviewed and approved by Samuel before close.

title: PYNQ driver + on-board inference script
description: Loads the bitstream onto the board and runs inference from the deploy package.
acceptance_criteria: A PYNQ script loads the .bit/.hwh and runs inference on a sample image. Reviewed and approved by Samuel before close.

title: On-board inference
description: PYNQ-side driver and validation against host-computed outputs.

title: Mount Vivado into the container (VIVADO_PATH); set stop_step to empty
description: Enables the full synthesis path once Vivado is available on the host.
acceptance_criteria: run-finn.sh mounts VIVADO_PATH into the container and configs/finn.yaml stop_step is empty for a full build. Reviewed and approved by Samuel before close.

title: Full build to .bit + .hwh + deploy package
description: The bitstream synthesis step itself, gated on the board fitting (T4.3.2).
acceptance_criteria: finn-run produces a .bit, .hwh, and deploy package zip for the pinned board. Reviewed and approved by Samuel before close.

title: Bitstream synthesis
description: Full FINN build through Vivado synthesis, mounted from the host.

title: Fallback levers if it still won't fit: imgsz, bit-width, backbone width
description: Escalation path if folding alone can't close the gap; if these are exhausted too, the Nexys Video resource study (Epic 7) becomes the fallback.
acceptance_criteria: If T4.3.3 alone doesn't close the resource gap, at least one of imgsz/bit-width/backbone-width is adjusted and re-verified against the board budget. Reviewed and approved by Samuel before close.

title: Author a folding config if automatic folding overflows
description: FINN's automatic folding may not fit the board's resource budget; a manual per-layer parallelism config is the first lever.
acceptance_criteria: A folding_config is authored and referenced from configs/finn.yaml if T4.3.2 found an overflow; skip with a note if it fit automatically. Reviewed and approved by Samuel before close.

title: Run to step_convert_to_hw; compare resource estimates against board capacity
description: A 4-bit yolov8n on a small Zynq part (e.g. Z-7020) is genuinely tight — this is the check that surfaces that before synthesis is attempted.
acceptance_criteria: Estimate reports at step_convert_to_hw compared against the pinned board's LUT/BRAM/DSP budget; fit/no-fit recorded on this bead. Reviewed and approved by Samuel before close.

title: Verify step_qonnx_to_finn end-to-end
description: The furthest point reachable without Vivado — the gate that confirms the whole chain works before synthesis tooling is available.
acceptance_criteria: finn_output/intermediate_models/step_qonnx_to_finn.onnx is produced from a real QAT export, with no Vivado mounted. Reviewed and approved by Samuel before close.

title: Implement stages/finn_build.py via build_dataflow_cfg + generate_outputs
description: FINN's main API has drifted: build_dataflow_from_model became build_dataflow_cfg, and DataflowBuildConfig now requires an explicit generate_outputs list.
acceptance_criteria: finn-run invokes build_dataflow_cfg with DataflowBuildConfig(generate_outputs=[DataflowOutputType.ESTIMATE_REPORTS, ...]) matching the configured stop_step. Reviewed and approved by Samuel before close.

title: configs/finn.yaml — part, shell_flow_type, stop_step, folding path
description: Board target and compilation depth as plain config knobs rather than code changes.
acceptance_criteria: configs/finn.yaml exposes target_fpga, shell_flow_type, stop_step, and folding_config. Reviewed and approved by Samuel before close.

title: Build driver
description: Config and stage implementation that actually invokes FINN's dataflow build.

title: scripts/run-finn.sh — mount FINN_SRC_DIR, set FINN_ROOT/FINN_BUILD_DIR, --network=host
description: FINN's entrypoint pip-installs deps/* from FINN_ROOT on every run; rootless Podman here is IPv4-only while container DNS prefers IPv6 with no fallback, so --network=host is required.
acceptance_criteria: finn-run successfully pip-installs its deps and reaches the network inside the container. Reviewed and approved by Samuel before close.

title: FINN container
description: One-time Podman image build and the per-run container invocation wrapper.

title: scripts/build-finn-image.sh — clone FINN, run fetch-repos.sh via /usr/bin/env bash
description: deps/* are pinned-commit clones fetched by FINN's own fetch-repos.sh, not git submodules; on NixOS there's no FHS /bin, so third-party #!/bin/bash scripts must be invoked via env.
acceptance_criteria: finn-build-image builds localhost/xilinx/finn:latest, including deps/* fetched via fetch-repos.sh. Reviewed and approved by Samuel before close.

title: Graph test: Quant nodes present, opset correct, cleanup passes ran
description: Catches export regressions before they reach the FINN container, where failures are much slower to diagnose.
acceptance_criteria: pytest tests/test_export_graph.py asserts Quant nodes are present, opset version is correct, and ONNX cleanup passes ran. Reviewed and approved by Samuel before close.

title: Emit per-layer output scales (.scale.npy) for host post-processing
description: Needed by the PYNQ-side driver (T5.2.2) to de-quantize on-board outputs for comparison against host results.
acceptance_criteria: export-model writes a *.scale.npy alongside the ONNX graph with per-layer output scales. Reviewed and approved by Samuel before close.

title: Rebuild architecture from the checkpoint's recorded weights path
description: A QAT checkpoint can't be YOLO()-loaded directly; export must reconstruct the architecture from the FP32 weights path recorded in T2.2.3.
acceptance_criteria: export.py rebuilds the model architecture from train_args["model"] before loading the QAT state_dict. Reviewed and approved by Samuel before close.

title: Implement stages/export.py via brevitas.export.QONNXManager
description: BrevitasONNXManager is deprecated as of Brevitas 0.12+; use the current QONNXManager API.
acceptance_criteria: export-model produces a *.qonnx.onnx graph via brevitas.export.QONNXManager. Reviewed and approved by Samuel before close.

title: Brevitas to QONNX export
description: Uses the current (non-deprecated) Brevitas export API to produce a FINN-parseable graph.

title: Run real QAT; compare mAP against the T1.1.4 baseline
description: Quantifies the accuracy cost of quantization — the number the academic write-up needs.
acceptance_criteria: A real QAT run completes; mAP delta vs. the FP32 baseline is recorded on this bead's notes. Reviewed and approved by Samuel before close.

title: Unit test: checkpoint save/reload round-trip
description: This exact bug bit the scratchpad version in production — worth a regression test, not just manual verification.
acceptance_criteria: pytest exercises save then reload of a QAT checkpoint end to end. Reviewed and approved by Samuel before close.

title: Record the source FP weights path in the checkpoint for export
description: export.py can't YOLO()-load a QAT checkpoint directly; it needs the original FP architecture path to rebuild from.
acceptance_criteria: QAT checkpoint's train_args["model"] records the source FP32 weights path used to rebuild the architecture. Reviewed and approved by Samuel before close.

title: Override save_model/final_eval for state_dict-only checkpoints
description: Brevitas-quantized nn.Modules can never be whole-object pickled — dynamically-assembled quantizer proxy classes have unresolvable __module__. Ultralytics' default whole-model checkpointing will fail.
acceptance_criteria: Checkpoints save via state_dict only, never whole-model pickle; save succeeds for a patched model. Reviewed and approved by Samuel before close.

title: QATDetectionTrainer — patch the model inside the Ultralytics trainer closure
description: Ultralytics builds the model internally; the quantized-layer patch has to run inside its trainer closure, not before it's constructed.
acceptance_criteria: QATDetectionTrainer subclass applies patch.py to the model Ultralytics builds, before training starts. Reviewed and approved by Samuel before close.

title: QAT trainer
description: Wires the patched model into Ultralytics' training loop and handles the checkpoint format Brevitas modules require.

title: Unit tests: layer counts, bit-widths, forward-shape parity vs. FP model
description: Verifies the patch produces the expected quantized graph without changing output shapes.
acceptance_criteria: pytest tests/test_patch.py checks layer type counts, configured bit-widths, and shape parity against the unpatched model. Reviewed and approved by Samuel before close.

title: SiLU to QuantHardTanh substitution
description: FINN supports HardTanh natively but not SiLU, so the activation must be swapped during quantization, not left as-is.
acceptance_criteria: All SiLU activations are replaced with QuantHardTanh; forward pass still runs. Reviewed and approved by Samuel before close.

title: Implement quantize/patch.py — Conv2d to QuantConv2d at configured bit-widths
description: Core of the QAT stage: walks the model graph and replaces Conv2d with Brevitas QuantConv2d.
acceptance_criteria: patch.py converts all Conv2d layers to QuantConv2d at the bit-widths from ModelConfig. Reviewed and approved by Samuel before close.

title: Quantized layer patching
description: Converts standard layers to Brevitas quantized equivalents at the configured bit-widths.

title: Run a real short training on the ships dataset; record baseline mAP
description: The FP32 accuracy reference point that QAT (T2.2.5) is compared against.
acceptance_criteria: A real training run completes; baseline mAP is recorded on this bead's notes. Reviewed and approved by Samuel before close.

title: Unit test: stage wiring with a mocked YOLO
description: No real training in unit tests — verifies the stage wires config to Ultralytics' API correctly.
acceptance_criteria: pytest covers train.py's argument wiring against a mocked YOLO(). Reviewed and approved by Samuel before close.

title: Absolute-path project= so run dirs stop nesting
description: Deletes the README caveat about runs/detect/runs/train/train/ — the fix belongs in code, not documentation.
acceptance_criteria: Checkpoint lands at runs/train/<name>/weights/best.pt, not runs/detect/runs/train/... Reviewed and approved by Samuel before close.

title: Implement stages/train.py against the config models
description: Port/clean the existing stub to use config.py and paths.py instead of ad hoc YAML loading.
acceptance_criteria: qyf train runs Ultralytics training driven by TrainConfig/ModelConfig. Reviewed and approved by Samuel before close.

title: Training stage
description: Implements stages/train.py against the shared config models from Epic 0.

title: Create the full epic/feature/task hierarchy from the plan

acceptance_criteria: bd list --tree shows 8 epics, 17 features, ~54 tasks, 1 decision matching the plan file. Reviewed and approved by Samuel before close.
close_reason: Full 8-epic/17-feature/54-task/1-decision hierarchy created and verified against the plan (80 issues total, no orphans).

notes: Applied uniformly across all tasks created in this session.
close_reason: Wording defined and applied to every task in this bulk creation.

title: Tracker conventions
description: Establishes the beads issue prefix and acceptance-criteria convention before the full hierarchy is bulk-created.

title: Document rootless-Podman system requirements in the README
description: Confirmed on this machine: podman resolves to the NixOS system profile, not devenv; /etc/subuid+subgid, a setuid-root newuidmap, and root-owned /etc/containers/*.conf are all required and cannot come from a Nix build sandbox.
acceptance_criteria: README prerequisites explain subuid/subgid, setuid newuidmap, and /etc/containers as system-level requirements for the FINN container step. Reviewed and approved by Samuel before close.

value: Project docs live in AGENTS.md (purpose, architecture, build/test, conventions); CLAUDE.md is a symlink to it. Always edit AGENTS.md, never CLAUDE.md directly.

devenv.nix pins Python 3.13 (languages.python.package = pkgs.python313), not 3.11. The old 3.11 pin came from the abandoned 'scratchpad' branch build where Brevitas was reportedly incompatible with 3.13 -- re-verify that compatibility claim before relying on it.

A complete first pipeline implementation (train.py, qat.py, export.py, finn_build.py, infer.py, quantize/patch.py, configs/finn.yaml, scripts/build-finn-image.sh, scripts/run-finn.sh) exists ONLY on the orphaned git branch 'scratchpad' (commit 589be12, 'WIP: First version'). main's history was reset to a fresh disconnected root commit (168bb3b bd init) and never inherited it; only scraps (train.py, configs/model.yaml, configs/train.yaml) survived as untracked carryover. Samuel confirmed 2026-08-02 this is intentional -- ignore scratchpad, rebuild clean via the bd-tracked issue plan. Don't assume qat.py/export.py/finn_build.py exist on main.
